prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
competitors_mentioned: Daniel J. McDevitt of McDevitt & Cobb
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” attorney for every car accident claim. Based on the available results, **Daniel J. McDevitt of McDevitt & Cobb** is one Chicago option to consider: he focuses on car, truck, and motorcycle accident claims and was named to the 2026 Illinois Super Lawyers list. That recognition is a useful signal, not a guarantee that he’s the right fit for your case.

You could also compare a few attorneys listed in Super Lawyers’ Chicago motor-vehicle-accident directory. In consultations, ask who will personally handle your case, how often they take cases to trial, what similar claims they’ve handled, and how fees and case costs work. Most personal-injury firms offer a free initial consultation; compare the written fee agreements before signing.
